svg.title: Vamos de compras — Multiplicación
svg.desc: Aplicación interactiva SVG para practicar multiplicación usando una tienda simulada con estanterías, canasta y monedas arrastrables.

g.text: Compra 3 jugos a 4 monedas cada uno.
Arrastra los productos a la canasta y luego paga.
Arrastra los productos a la canasta.

svg.script: (function(){ const svg = document.documentElement; const missionText = document.getElementById('missionText'); const missionHint = document.getElementById('missionHint'); const totalTarget = document.getElementById('totalTarget'); const basketCountText = document.getElementById('basketCountText'); const paidText = document.getElementById('paidText'); const equationText = document.getElementById('equationText'); const feedbackText = document.getElementById('feedbackText'); const scoreText = document.getElementById('scoreText'); const basketDrop = document.getElementById('basketDrop'); const walletDrop = document.getElementById('walletDrop'); const products = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.product')); const coins = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.coin')); let round = 0; let score = 0; let targetType = 'jugo'; let targetName = 'Jugo'; let targetQty = 3; let targetPrice = 4; let targetTotal = 12; let basketItems = []; let paid = 0; const missions = [ {type:'jugo', name:'Jugo', qty:3, price:4}, {type:'manzana', name:'Manzana', qty:4, price:3}, {type:'galletas', name:'Galletas', qty:2, price:5}, {type:'pan', name:'Pan', qty:5, price:2}, {type:'leche', name:'Leche', qty:2, price:6}, {type:'banano', name:'Banano', qty:3, price:4} ]; function setFeedback(text, good){ feedbackText.textContent = text; feedbackText.setAttribute('fill', good === true ? '#258a59' : good === false ? '#c24a45' : '#17324d'); } function startMission(index){ const m = missions[index % missions.length]; targetType = m.type; targetName = m.name; targetQty = m.qty; targetPrice = m.price; targetTotal = targetQty * targetPrice; basketItems = []; paid = 0; updateUI(); missionText.textContent = `Compra ${targetQty} ${targetName.toLowerCase()}${targetQty>1?'s':''} a ${targetPrice} monedas cada uno.`; missionHint.textContent = 'Arrastra los productos a la canasta y luego paga el total.'; totalTarget.textContent = `${targetTotal} monedas`; equationText.textContent = `${targetQty} × ${targetPrice} = ?`; setFeedback('Arrastra los productos a la canasta.', null); } function updateUI(){ basketCountText.textContent = `Productos: ${basketItems.length} / ${targetQty}`; paidText.textContent = `Pagado: ${paid}`; scoreText.textContent = score; } function svgPoint(evt){ const pt = svg.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = evt.clientX; pt.y = evt.clientY; return pt.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse()); } function pointInRect(x, y, rectEl){ const bb = rectEl.getBBox(); const ctm = rectEl.getCTM(); const inv = ctm.inverse(); const p = svg.createSVGPoint(); p.x = x; p.y = y; const lp = p.matrixTransform(inv); return lp.x >= bb.x && lp.x <= bb.x + bb.width && lp.y >= bb.y && lp.y <= bb.y + bb.height; } function cloneForDrag(original){ const clone = original.cloneNode(true); clone.removeAttribute('id'); clone.classList.add('drag-copy'); clone.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; svg.appendChild(clone); return clone; } function makeDraggable(el, kind){ let dragging = false; let clone = null; el.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(evt){ evt.preventDefault(); dragging = true; clone = cloneForDrag(el); clone.classList.add('dragging'); try { el.setPointerCapture(evt.pointerId); } catch(e){} moveClone(evt); }); function moveClone(evt){ if(!dragging || !clone) return; const p = svgPoint(evt); clone.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${p.x},${p.y}) scale(1.02)`); } el.addEventListener('pointermove', moveClone); el.addEventListener('pointerup', function(evt){ if(!dragging) return; dragging = false; const p = svgPoint(evt); if(kind === 'product'){ const type = el.getAttribute('data-type'); if(pointInRect(p.x, p.y, basketDrop)){ if(type === targetType){ if(basketItems.length < targetQty){ basketItems.push(type); setFeedback(`Bien: ${basketItems.length} de ${targetQty} ${targetName.toLowerCase()}${targetQty>1?'s':''}.`, true); } else { setFeedback('Ya tienes la cantidad necesaria.', null); } } else { setFeedback(`Ese producto no corresponde. Busca ${targetName.toLowerCase()}.`, false); } } } else if(kind === 'coin'){ const value = Number(el.getAttribute('data-value')); if(pointInRect(p.x, p.y, walletDrop)){ paid += value; if(paid <= targetTotal){ setFeedback(`Llevas ${paid} de ${targetTotal} monedas.`, true); } else { setFeedback(`Te pasaste: llevas ${paid}. Puedes iniciar una nueva compra.`, false); } } } updateUI(); if(clone && clone.parentNode) clone.parentNode.removeChild(clone); clone = null; }); el.addEventListener('pointercancel', function(){ dragging = false; if(clone && clone.parentNode) clone.parentNode.removeChild(clone); clone = null; }); } products.forEach(p => makeDraggable(p,'product')); coins.forEach(c => makeDraggable(c,'coin')); document.getElementById('hintBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ const repeated = Array(targetQty).fill(targetPrice).join(' + '); missionHint.textContent = `${targetQty} grupos de ${targetPrice}: ${repeated} = ${targetTotal}`; equationText.textContent = `${targetQty} × ${targetPrice} = ${targetTotal}`; setFeedback('Usa la suma repetida para comprobar.', null); }); document.getElementById('checkBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ const productsOK = basketItems.length === targetQty; const moneyOK = paid === targetTotal; if(productsOK && moneyOK){ score += 10; updateUI(); equationText.textContent = `${targetQty} × ${targetPrice} = ${targetTotal}`; setFeedback('¡Excelente! Formaste grupos iguales y pagaste el total correcto. 🎉', true); } else if(!productsOK && !moneyOK){ setFeedback(`Aún faltan productos y el pago debe ser exactamente ${targetTotal}.`, false); } else if(!productsOK){ setFeedback(`Revisa la cantidad: necesitas ${targetQty} productos.`, false); } else { setFeedback(`Revisa el pago: debe ser exactamente ${targetTotal} monedas.`, false); } }); document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ round = (round + 1) % missions.length; startMission(round); }); startMission(0);})();
